questions.question: What declarative Python visualization library builds on Vega-Lite and the Grammar of Graphics?
questions.explanation: Altair provides a declarative API based on Vega and Vega-Lite specifications.

questions.question: What JavaScript library creates custom interactive data visualizations?
questions.explanation: D3.js binds data to DOM elements for flexible visualizations.

questions.question: What technique reduces overplotting by adding random jitter?
questions.explanation: Jittering adds small random noise to separate overlapping points.

questions.question: What visualization shows parallel coordinates for multivariate data?
questions.explanation: Parallel coordinates display high-dimensional data across parallel axes.

questions.question: What method visualizes dimensionality reduction results in 2D?
questions.explanation: t-SNE plots show high-dimensional data clusters in lower dimensions.

questions.question: What chart displays flow between stages in a process?
questions.explanation: Sankey diagrams show flows with proportional widths between nodes.

questions.question: What visualization combines geographic maps with data overlays?
questions.explanation: Choropleth maps use colors to represent data values across regions.

questions.question: What library integrates with geographic data for mapping?
questions.explanation: Folium creates interactive maps using Leaflet.js in Python.

questions.question: What technique handles transparency to show overlapping density?
questions.explanation: Alpha blending uses transparency to reveal overlapping data patterns.

questions.question: What chart shows time-oriented data with range and uncertainty?
questions.explanation: Ribbon charts display confidence intervals or ranges over time.

questions.question: Which chart should you use to show customer drop-off between sequential stages of a sales process?
questions.explanation: Funnel charts show shrinking values through sequential process stages.

questions.question: What map distorts geographic areas proportionally to a data value like population?
questions.explanation: Cartograms resize regions so area encodes a statistic.

questions.question: What seaborn visualization adds hierarchical dendrograms to a heatmap?
questions.explanation: clustermap reorders a heatmap by hierarchical clustering of rows and columns.

questions.question: What plot compares a sample's quantiles against a theoretical distribution's quantiles?
questions.explanation: Q-Q plots reveal departures from a reference distribution such as the normal.

questions.question: What seaborn class creates a grid of charts conditioned on categorical variables?
questions.explanation: FacetGrid maps a plotting function across a grid of data subsets.

questions.question: A quality dashboard must show defect causes as bars sorted in descending order plus a cumulative percentage line to highlight the 'vital few'. Which chart is this?
questions.explanation: A Pareto chart combines descending bars with a cumulative line, embodying the 80/20 principle.

questions.question: An analyst wants to show how the ranking of 8 products changed between last year and this year, with one line per product connecting its two ranks. Which chart fits best?
questions.explanation: A slope chart (or bump chart for rankings) connects each item's value or rank across two points, emphasizing changes in position.

questions.question: A scatter plot of 500,000 points is an unreadable blob of overlapping marks. Instead of adding jitter, which technique aggregates points into hexagonal cells colored by count?
questions.explanation: Hexbin plots bin the plane into hexagons and encode density by color, solving massive overplotting.

questions.question: Which chart displays hierarchical part-to-whole data as nested rectangles whose areas are proportional to values?
questions.explanation: Treemaps nest rectangles inside one another, sizing each by its share of the total.

questions.question: A report needs a map where a sized bubble centered on each country encodes its GDP per capita. Which visualization is this?
questions.explanation: Proportional symbol maps scale point symbols over regions by a data value, unlike choropleths which shade region fill color.
